name: AVEVA
grund: Gefahr 4/5, 6 Erwähnungen: AVEVA’s collaboration with NVIDIA to build lifecycle digital twin architectures for large-scale AI factories indicates a strong focus on industrial 3D visualization and data integration, directly competing with Threedy’s digital twin and industrial AI use cases.

name: Schneider Electric
grund: Gefahr 4/5, 6 Erwähnungen: Schneider Electric’s use of NVIDIA Omniverse DSX to build AI-powered digital twins in industrial environments directly competes with Threedy’s digital twin and AI-driven 3D visualization applications.

name: Synera
grund: Gefahr 4/5, 3 Erwähnungen: Synera's focus on AI-driven engineering workflows with integrated CAD visualization and its use of Tech Soft 3D's HOOPS AI toolkit indicates a strong overlap with Threedy's use cases in industrial AI and 3D data interaction, particularly in digital twin and design collaboration scenarios.

name: Visual Components
grund: Gefahr 4/5, 2 Erwähnungen: Visual Components' FactoryLens delivers realistic 3D manufacturing simulations with real-time visualization, directly overlapping with Threedy's industrial use cases in digital twins, production planning, and service visualization.
